title: Log Analytics Workspaces
description: Set up and configure Log Analytics workspaces to collect and store Azure monitoring data.

data.text: What Is a Log Analytics Workspace?

A Log Analytics workspace is a unique environment for Azure Monitor log data. Each workspace has its own data repository and configuration. Resources across Azure send their logs to one or more workspaces, where you can query, analyze, and visualize the data using KQL.

terms.definition: A unique identifier for a Log Analytics workspace used in API and agent configuration.
A secret used to authenticate data ingestion into the workspace.
How long data is kept in the workspace. Standard is 30 days; extended retention is available up to 2 years.
The process of sending log data into the workspace via diagnostic settings or agents.

data.title: Create a Log Analytics Workspace (Azure CLI)
data.code:
az monitor log-analytics workspace create \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --workspace-name myWorkspace \
  --location eastus \
  --retention-time 30

data.title: How Data Gets Into a Workspace
items: Diagnostic Settings: Configure Azure resources to send logs and metrics.
Agents: Install the Log Analytics agent on VMs or Arc-enabled servers.
Azure Monitor Agent (AMA): The newer, unified agent for VMs, App Service, and Kubernetes.
Custom Sources: Use the Data Collector API to push logs from any app or service.

rows: App logs, web server logs, metrics

data.title: Workspace Strategy
data.text: A single workspace is simplest for small setups. For enterprise, consider separate workspaces per environment (dev, staging, prod) to enforce data access boundaries and retention policies.

data.title: Set Up a Workspace for an App
data.description: Create a workspace and connect an App Service to it.
steps: Create a new Log Analytics workspace.
Enable diagnostic settings on an App Service to send AppServiceConsoleLogs to the workspace.
Verify the connection in the Log Analytics workspace under Workspace Data Sources.
Note the workspace ID and primary key.
data.expectedOutcome: App Service logs are visible in the workspace within a few minutes.
